spy_daily_raw.csv.description: Daily OHLCV bars for SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (America/New_York 16:00 Close)
spy_daily_raw.csv.observation_convention: Close_t is 16:00 ET close on event date t. Close_{t+1} is 16:00 ET close on next trading day.

treasury_2y_raw.csv.source: Yahoo Finance (ZT=F, 2-Year T-Note Futures) and Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED (DGS2, 2-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Yield)
treasury_2y_raw.csv.description: Daily 2-Year Treasury Note Futures prices and FRED constant maturity yield (DGS2)
treasury_2y_raw.csv.observation_convention: DGS2_{t+1} - DGS2_t represents daily constant maturity yield difference; ZT_Close_{t+1} - ZT_Close_t is price points difference.

caveats: NOT a full event-day reaction from pre-statement baseline
NOT an intraday monetary policy surprise (e.g. 14:00 to 14:30 window)
Measures return/yield change from event day market close (16:00 ET) to next trading day close
